assignment_source: The nine numbered items in the worker assignment; core-update-2d is absent from the base tasks.json. No plan/task/control-plane files were changed.

items.name: Service-principal reads
items.result: Existing read scopes cover deadline/calendar get/list, matter-party contact filter, firm time zone, addresses, party roles, custom-field definitions and directory/work email; each new read has a live per-operation limit.

items.name: Walled record reads
items.result: Only inside-wall viewers or approved expiring exact-record grants; no list/write/sibling/attorney-only bypass. Metadata identifies permitted users, including contact-derived walls. Directory checks each candidate. REST/MCP grants and header-override refusals are tested.

items.name: Module mail
items.result: mail:send service calls resolve only contact parties on the named accessible matter; matter/outbox/audit/timeline attribution retained.

items.name: Own and contract settings
items.result: Own reads audited; contract runtime setting allowlist under settings:read and approved contract permission; own-settings setup write uses module_settings:write and an admin viewer. modules:write stays forbidden.

items.name: Contracts
items.result: Provider-audience forwarded contexts verify/delegate and expire with unlinking; stable targeted envelope is preserved and deduplicated; oversized responses return too_large. Compatibility comparison with separately held definitions remains pending because docs/contracts/ was absent at base.

items.name: Webhooks and helpers
items.result: Timestamp+body HMAC, matching timestamp header, nonempty secret and bidirectional window checks; per-hook Authorization forwarding requires approved webhooks:authorization and is never core auth; public provider CRC/HMAC helpers.

items.name: Purge and activity
items.result: Purge holds bytes while module RESTRICT links exist and names retainers. New module event actors are named in shared timeline and activity streams without rewriting append-only history.

items.name: Public kit inventory, pending and converter
items.result: Migration inventory matches Goose Up. Runtime criteria remain explicitly held until supported, then strict checks refuse stale entries. coretest conversion is in process, including invalid-output/failure/access tests; other CLI paths point inside a test directory.

items.name: Contact phone-row slot
items.result: Approved contacts:read manifest items render beside phones; sandboxed action frames recheck access. Paginated REST/MCP discovery uses the same access path.

tests.name: Changed-package race regression
tests.result: All 14 package groups passed. Docker/pinned-binary checks use their existing availability gates; no test was edited to skip or weaken coverage.

tests.name: Broad composed-core race regression
tests.result: Passed in 330.957 seconds, covering service scopes/walls, module lifecycle, mail, contracts, OpenAPI/MCP, firm directory, event feed and fresh-install setup. The external-repository CU2-07 check was not selected.

tests.name: Final public-surface race regression
tests.result: All passed, including five core-update-2d Postgres acceptance tests and the runtime-criterion CLI checks.

tests.name: API contract suite and regeneration
tests.result: 130 tests; core and marketplace OpenAPI validation; deliberately broken reference rejected; regenerated artifacts byte-identical. Runtime simulator fixtures are not executed by this check.

tests.name: Formatting and diff
tests.command: test -z "$(gofmt -l cmd internal pkg)" && git diff --check

tests.name: Final core surface regression
tests.result: Passed in 55.585 seconds after the party/contact-channel grant addition.

tests.name: Domain read-only event credential and file access tests
tests.result: Both packages passed. Event credentials cannot grant writes or attorney-only access inside services.

pending_checks.reason: docs/contracts/ did not exist in base. The implemented envelope is documented and tested in docs/contracts/README.md; compare any separately held batch-2 provider/consumer definitions before claiming their compatibility.

failures_and_fixes: Standalone unprojected practice stores initially lost their document events; preserved that path while projected composed installs query the shared stream by matter/time window.
Updated existing assertions for intentional service-contact mail and named module actors, with delivery/matter/actor checks retained and strengthened.
Added ordinary cursor pagination to phone-item discovery to satisfy the API list contract.
Named-contact grant initially failed on a separate custom-field read; exact-record responses now omit related custom-field/extension reads.
No tests were disabled or weakened. No release/tag/public version change or push/PR operation was performed.

simplification.review: Reused existing scoped service principals, wall services, module FK holder inspection, signing, settings, pagination and public harness. Shared event-actor identity avoids divergent writers. Metadata only inspects authorized core rows, never arbitrary included module columns.

release: No release, tag or public version bump.
